stories.headline: Dem fundraising giant makes damning admission as GOP probes foreign donation allegations
stories.note: ActBlue rolled out passport checks just days after House GOP investigators accused it of possibly taking foreign donations.

stories.headline: Millions saved by blocking dead people payouts as Trump Treasury drops hammer on federal fraud
stories.note: Treasury's "Do Not Pay" screening caught 13,500 improper payments to dead people, a clear anti-fraud win for the administration.

stories.headline: Trump clears way for Fort Hood terrorist to face Army firing squad nearly 17 years after massacre
stories.note: Trump delivers justice for the 13 people killed at Fort Hood after years of delay.

stories.headline: NYT columnist thrashed online for suggesting Trump is to blame for alleged Cornell gang rape
stories.note: A New York Times columnist got roasted for blaming Trump for an alleged crime that happened under Biden.

stories.headline: Dem senator who demanded Saudi accountability over Khashoggi meets with crown prince, pushes Palestinian state
stories.note: Chris Murphy met with Mohammed bin Salman and skipped any mention of Khashoggi, a hypocrisy hit on a top Democrat.

stories.headline: Trump to announce $6.6B US investment with Anduril for Baltimore sub facility
stories.note: A $6.6 billion defense-manufacturing investment headed to Baltimore, with Trump front and center.

stories.headline: Texas Dem Senate nominee James Talarico put on defense after 2020 comments about defunding police resurface: 'We must replace'
stories.note: Resurfaced defund-the-police comments hand Paxton fresh ammo in the toss-up Texas Senate race.

stories.headline: Apple News hid stories about how broke the DNC is ahead of the midterms, watchdog alleges
stories.note: A watchdog says Apple News buried stories on the DNC's debt, putting Democrats' cash problems back in the spotlight.
